report:
Conclusion: The evidence supports a domain/content shift between the checkpoints. Model B (B − A) is biased toward tokens about restaurants/food/cooking/blogging and other small-business / commercial-style topics.

Why I believe that
- The highest-norm (layer,position) cells (especially late layers, positions 1–4) consistently point to tokens like "restaurant", "Restaurant", "cooking", "Cooking", "Chef", "Chef", "baking", "Cake", "blogs", "blogging", "Cafe", "Kitchen", "recipes"/related words. These tokens appear across many of the top cells in layers ~16–25 (logit-lens output).
- Many other high-scoring tokens are in the same topical neighborhood: "culinary", "restaurant", "professional" (as in "professional"/"Professional"), "Magazine", "Cook", "Made", "hot", "kitchen", etc. This is a coherent cluster that reads like food/restaurant/cooking and related commercial/blog content.
- The L2-norm pattern shows the difference concentrated in later layers and especially at early token positions (pos1 largest in many late layers), which is consistent with a change that will affect how the model continues a prompt (i.e., steering next-token probabilities toward that domain).

Caveats and limits
- Patchscope readouts were not available in the evidence, so I can’t demonstrate the actual continuations produced when the difference is injected; the claim is based mainly on logit-lens top tokens and where the difference lives in the model.
- Some early-layer pos0 top tokens (e.g., "Me", "corporations", "revenue", "chiropractic", "billionaire", "doctoral") suggest additional commercial/health/education /entity-focused tokens are involved, so the shift may be broader than only "food" (a general tilt toward commercial/local-business / lifestyle content). The strongest, most consistent signal, however, is the restaurant/culinary/blogging cluster.

So: I would characterize the difference as a domain bias in Model B toward restaurant/cooking/blogging and related commercial/local-business language (with some other commercial/health/education tokens also present). The evidence does not identify a precise training objective, only this topical/content difference.
